sites.notes: No in-range DTL order listed. DTL rows on the Tariff Orders listing: True-up FY2021-22 (25/10/2025, https://www.derc.gov.in/sites/default/files/True-up%20of%20FY%202021-22_DTL.pdf), True-up FY2020-21 (19/07/2024), Tariff Order FY2021-22 (12/10/2021), and older. The newest section 'True Up Orders for FY 2022-23' (31/12/2025) lists IPGCL, PPCL, NDMC, BRPL, BYPL, TPDDL but no DTL, and no tariff orders after FY2021-22 are listed. Out-of-range DTL FY2021-22 true-up was not included in orders.

No in-range transmission-utility ARR/true-up/MYT order found. Goa and the UTs are served by integrated Electricity Departments (orders titled for 'Electricity Department', e.g. True-up FY2024-25 for ED Goa); Dadra and Nagar Haveli 'Transmission Division' tariff orders on the site are FY2018-19 (250/2017) and FY2019-20 (271/2018), out of range. Chandigarh has a State Transmission Utility Business Plan order (Petition 182/2026, https://jercuts.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/STU-order-final-1.pdf) for FY2025-26..FY2029-30 - a business-plan order, not an ARR/tariff order, so excluded. Category pages were checked by link and row text for 'transmission/STU/transco'.

http_note: http = status of a ranged GET (-r 0-1023, curl -L); 206 means partial content served as requested, i.e. the URL answers; content type was application/pdf for every URL recorded.
